prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `SubmissionState`, `SubmissionInput`, `Submission`, `SubmissionReport`, and `SubmissionDesk`.

States are `"pending"`, `"accepted"`, and `"declined"`. A submission input has non-blank `title` and `author` strings plus a readonly string array `tags`. Construction of `SubmissionDesk` creates an empty desk. `create(input)` trims title, author, and every tag; blank title, author, or tag throws `RangeError`. It returns a submission with deterministic ID `S1`, `S2`, and so on, initial state `pending`, and tags in input order. Invalid creation must not consume an ID.

`setState(id, state)` trims the ID, throws `RangeError` for blank IDs, and throws `Error("Unknown submission: " + id)` when absent. A pending submission may become accepted or declined. Reapplying its current state is a no-op. Every other transition throws `Error("Invalid state transition")`.

`report()` returns `{ total, submissions }` in creation order. All inputs, returned submissions, and reports must be defensively copied so external mutation cannot change stored data.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
